## About
My father started General Mecanic with one goal: to give great automotive service that meets the highest standards of quality. He never settled for less, and the policy he started is one we still follow today.
Juan Carrera and Gilberto Salas co-own the shop and run our tow truck. Denis Lazo is our foreman and automotive technician, and Reyna Salgado is at the front desk as your service advisor. Every repair is done on-site, so your vehicle stays under our care from start to finish.
We're a family business, and we treat you as family, too. Our customers have given us a 4.9 rating from 222 Google reviews.

## Services
- North Carolina Safety Inspection: The yearly inspection you need before renewing your plate. We check brakes, tires, lights and signals, steering and suspension, wipers, mirrors and horn.
- North Carolina Emission Inspection: Required in some counties along with your safety inspection. We test through your car's computer. A vehicle with a check engine light on will fail.
- Diagnostics: We test your vehicle's electrical system to find the exact cause, whether it's the battery, alternator, starter, wiring or sensors. That way you pay for the right repair the first time instead of guessing at parts. (start at $120)
- Engine / Transmissions: Full engine and transmission replacement or installation, with new, rebuilt or used units. We inspect, clean, replace fluids and set up sensors, wiring and mounts so it runs right.
- Alignment: Want a better ride? We align your vehicle to original specifications.
- Suspension Repairs: Worn shocks, struts, ball joints and bushings cause noises, uneven tire wear and a rough ride. We fix them to bring back handling and comfort.
- Heating & A/C: A/C not blowing cold or heater not warming up? We find the cause, recharge refrigerant and replace worn parts.
- Tires: Tire inspections, rotations, balancing, repairs and replacements for safer handling and shorter stops.

## FAQ
Q: How much will it cost me?
A: Our diagnostic services start at $120. That tells us what's wrong and what the total repair will cost.

Q: I need a small automotive job. Can you do it?
A: Yes. No job is too big and no job is too small. We handle all automotive repairs with the same care.

Q: Do you offer services for business?
A: We service commercial vehicles, and our pricing stays the same for every customer.
